# PR #307 : réponses proposées aux commentaires

Brouillons en anglais, à poster seulement si tu es d'accord. Un commentaire par personne.

## À ifBars (boucle sans retour en arrière)

> Thanks, you're right: `Tracer::waterfall` matched the compare without checking it sits in a loop, and `classify` took any first-lane read as per-lane. Fixed in 6285e19: a compare only counts when it and the `v_readfirstlane_b32` it reads are in one loop (each block reaches the other), and a descriptor read from the first lane needs every dword compared that way, otherwise translation stops with "a descriptor read from the first lane outside a waterfall loop". Your case (the back edge replaced by `s_nop`) is now the regression test `a_first_lane_read_outside_a_loop_is_no_waterfall`; both new tests fail without the change. On the game's 25,985 shader containers the stricter check refuses no program that translated before, so real waterfall loops are unaffected.

## À r4tedx (compilation + question sur le compare)

> Thanks for the build report: the `translate.rs` match is fixed in 077ec8b (`Fetched` counted like `Loaded`, `Select`/`Lanes` never leaves). On the design question: agreed, the compare is now required (6285e19). A first-lane descriptor whose dwords are not all checked by a `v_cmp_eq` inside the same loop is refused; `a_first_lane_read_without_its_compare_is_no_waterfall` covers it.
